description: R5/M18 (§23): live updates of the story list. The `stories` topic sends, after every input, the rows whose key (stage, latest and closing bar, validity, tier, feed place, coin-flip mark, redaction) changed: births, transitions, closings, validity changes, feed-place changes after an audience change; and, to a reader without the licensed flow, the server comments on that instrument. Unsubscribing stops it.
name: 63-stories-live

steps.note: The chart opened: the list was asked for, then its changes (the state at subscription is the answer above: no event).
A topic for an instrument without a bar series: `not_found`.

Each final bar is one engine entry; after it the authority sends a `story` row for every story born, moved, closed, or whose validity changed — for each reader in its own world (Bora and Can: public stories; Bora also the server comments on the topic).
